responsibility: Owns immutable evidence observations and the recorded conflicts between them.
mutation_interface: EvidenceAuthority.admit and EvidenceAuthority.record_conflict through AuthorityStore.insert — admit is a privileged import seam and requires a non-empty admission_basis; there is no generic record alias and no public route reaches it
failure_boundary: fail_closed — evidence cannot be amended or deleted, and a detected conflict is recorded rather than resolved, which downstream turns into a HOLD
recovery_behavior: Each observation carries its own content hash and original language, so a partially ingested evidence set is detectable and re-appendable without rewriting any existing row
replacement_contract: A replacement must keep observations immutable, require an admission basis on every admitted observation, preserve the antecedent's original language alongside derived content, and record conflicts without inventing a resolution
evidence_produced: admission_basis naming the trusted import path for every observation
evidence_conflicts rows with the conflicting subject and detail
